Strategy: Fill two thirds of the bin. Prefer the bin where the item takes two thirds of the residual, leaving one third free: the item dominates while keeping a useful remainder. Score by distance from a two-thirds fill, so ranking can differ from Best Fit whenever the two-thirds bin is not the tightest. It may help by keeping placements mostly tight yet reusable, but may fail by passing up tight fits for bins that stay one third empty.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(abs(item / r - 2 / 3)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Two-thirds fill targeting: score by -abs(item/r - 2/3), prefer residual = 1.5*item.
